Dear Renata,
It is with great enthusiasm that I recommend Mia Karlsson
for the position at Printed Page Publishers. Mia has been an
exceptional student in my creative writing courses,
consistently demonstrating a strong work ethic and a
passion for storytelling.
Her ability to take constructive feedback and improve her
craft is truly impressive. I am confident she will bring
creativity and dedication to your team.
Sincerely,
Kristi Laar
